about_the_game:
Description

Embark on a magical adventure where each card is a step towards dangers and treasures! "Like a Fairytale" is a unique card roguelike about heroes battling against mythical creatures from Slavic folklore.

Face mighty bosses whose unprecedented powers change the rules of battle. Protect your riches from cunning enemies and craft magical curiosities from collected trophies. Return to the king with your reward or risk everything by venturing further for more valuable treasures.

Game Features

🔥 MIGHTY BOSSES

Each boss changes the rules of battle, requiring special tactics and ingenuity. The Nightingale Robber blows your items off the battlefield, the Dragon Gorynych attacks with multiple heads simultaneously, and Koschei the Deathless hides his death in an intricate chain of items.

🛠️ MAGICAL CRAFTING

Combine cards to create useful curiosities that will help you in your adventure. Turn iron and an anvil into a mighty sword, and simple ingredients into protective runes or healing potions. Experiment with dozens of combinations and discover new recipes!

⚔️ DANGEROUS ADVENTURES

Guard your treasures — they can be stolen, frozen, or even blown away by the wind! Enemies not only attack the hero but also seek to deprive him of valuable resources. Develop protection strategies and be prepared for any surprises.

🗺️ HERO'S PATH

Return with your loot or continue your journey for greater rewards, risking everything. After each day of adventure, make a decision — end your quest or test fate by venturing deeper into the fairy-tale world, where dangers and rewards become increasingly significant.

Who Our Game Is For

  • Fans of card roguelikes and tactical games

  • Enthusiasts of Slavic mythology and fairy tales

  • Players who value strategic depth and tactical variety

  • Anyone seeking a unique gaming experience with numerous discoveries

Set off on a journey through a fairy-tale world and become a hero of legends!
